frontMatter.title: Week 4 of Our Summer Club Night
frontMatter.summary: Join us at Claremont Stadium from 8pm to 11pm for rally marathons. For just €8, be part of the excitement. Whether you're experienced or new to the game, come and have fun. Grab your racket and sports gear, and join us this Wednesday night!
